whatIsBathymetricSurveys.headline: What is Bathymetric Surveys?
whatIsBathymetricSurveys.description: Bathymetric surveys involve measuring the depth of water bodies and charting the underwater terrain. This technique is crucial for understanding sediment levels, water volume, and underwater hazards. It supports safer construction, better water resource management, and proactive environmental protection. SmartGrid Surveying uses high-resolution echo sounders, GNSS positioning systems, and remote-controlled survey boats to access shallow and restricted water zones safely and efficiently.
